_meta.purpose: Canonical name registry for all project entities. Single source of truth. Check this before writing any entity name in code, config, or docs.

env-assert.description: Ensure that the environment variables match what you need, or abort. Module and executable.

env-dot.description: Sister project. Read environment variables from a .env file directly into your program. Also provides envdot script.

env-assert-module.description: Main module. Asserts environment on import via 'use Env::Assert'.

env-assert-functions.description: Core functionality. Exports assert, report_errors, file_to_desc and error constants.

envassert.description: CLI script. Reads .envdesc and checks environment variables.

envassert-self-contained.description: FatPacked standalone executable. No CPAN dependencies needed, only Perl.

assert.description: Core assertion function. Compares environment hash against description hash.

report_errors.description: Formats assertion errors for human-readable output.

file_to_desc.description: Parses .envdesc file rows into a description hashref with options and variables.

break-at-first-error.description: Stop checking at first error. Default: false.

env-description.description: Path to environment description file. Default: .envdesc.

exact.description: Fail if environment contains variables not in description. Overrides .envdesc option.

stdin.description: Read environment description from STDIN instead of file.

mikkoi-bundle.description: Dist::Zilla plugin bundle used in dist.ini.

test2-platform-guards.description: Custom test guard modules. Require or Deny runs on specific platforms (OS, CI).

envassert-script.description: Tests envassert CLI with .envdesc file input.

envassert-script-three.description: Tests envassert CLI with error scenarios (missing var).
